topic: Ambient Lamp Local Control Module Functionality

core_entities.name: CnsoLHALampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Local control signal for ambient lamp color change request. Value 0x00 indicates no request.

core_entities.name: CnsoLHALampOnOff_1
core_entities.description: Local control signal for turning the ambient lamp on/off. Value 0x0 indicates OFF.

core_entities.name: CnsoLHALampFadeSpdCmd_1
core_entities.description: Parameter defining the fade speed when turning off the ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: ZCU_LIN
core_entities.description: LIN communication signal from Zone Control Unit (ZCU).

core_entities.name: Ambient Lamp Module
core_entities.description: Module responsible for driving and controlling the ambient lamps.

core_conditions.description: Trigger condition for initiating a color change request.
Exit condition for maintaining current color without change.
Trigger condition for turning off the ambient lamp.

core_conditions.condition: Overvoltage or undervoltage fault in Ambient Lamp Module
core_conditions.description: Fault condition requiring immediate shutdown of the ambient lamp.

core_conditions.condition: No ZCU LIN signal received for >6 seconds
core_conditions.description: Timeout condition leading to automatic shutdown of the ambient lamp.
Fault condition where the color command signal is invalid.

core_outputs.description: Signal sent to the ambient lamp driver module to control its color based on the lookup table.
State of the ambient lamp (on/off, color, fade speed) as controlled by the module.

core_faults.description: Fault detected in the ambient lamp module power supply.
Failure to receive expected LIN signals from the ZCU within the defined timeout period.
Abnormal value received in the CnsoLHALampColorCmd_1 signal.

core_timing_constraints.description: If no LIN signal is received within 6 seconds, the ambient lamp is turned off.
